verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents scorers that run inside evaluations of tasks against simulated worlds and frozen environments. Production traces can be ingested and turned into tasks, but nothing shows scorers running continuously on live production traffic. The marketing line about 'real-time monitoring of production agents' describes monitoring and rollback, not online evaluators, so it is an adjacent feature rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets
